summary: Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting that Chairman and CIO Mario Gabelli was hospitalized on March 19, 2026 after a medical incident. The fund's parent, GAMCO, activated its succession plan; Christopher Marangi was named President, while co-CEO Douglas Jamieson and Marangi lead daily operations. The Gabelli Value team's co-CIOs manage the fund during Gabelli's absence. No tender, acquisition, or capital event is involved. The filing serves as disclosure of a temporary, forced management departure due to health, though not an abrupt board removal. Watch for recovery timeline updates.
